summary: Top KingWin Ltd filed a supplemental proxy statement on Form 6-K revising Proposals 7 and 8 for its upcoming Extraordinary General Meeting on August 31, 2026. The revisions detail a 50-for-1 share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective December 17, 2026, rounding fractional shares up, and amend the Fifth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association to correct the par value. The board unanimously recommends a vote for all revised proposals. No transaction terms, prices, or strategic changes are involved; this is a routine corporate mechanics matter.
